title: Lymphatic system anatomy
description: The body's drainage and defence network: interstitial fluid returns as lymph, filtered node by node, while immune cells patrol.

questions.question: What does the lymphatic system do?
questions.answer: It returns excess interstitial fluid to the bloodstream, transports absorbed fats from the intestine and supports immune surveillance through nodes and lymphoid organs.

questions.question: Where does lymph drain back into the blood?
questions.answer: Large lymphatic ducts empty near the junctions of the internal jugular and subclavian veins. The thoracic duct drains most of the body.

questions.question: What is the cervical nodes?
questions.answer: Chains along jugular and spine. Function: Drain head and neck.

questions.question: Where is the inguinal nodes located?
questions.answer: Horizontal + vertical groups in the groin. Function: Drain leg, perineum and lower abdominal wall.

questions.question: What is the function of the thymus?
questions.answer: Function: T-cell maturation in childhood. Bilobed school for T cells, behind sternum.
